text:
alex: Heads up — saw regional route churn in eu-west after the affinity weight tweak. traffic flips every ~20-40s between pools.
maya: saw it too. my initial trace shows probe_score deltas oscillating around zero, tie-breaker alternates.
jordan: is it probe timestamp granularity or smoothing window? paste the logs if you have them.
alex: logs: routing: decide(tenant=acme) -> scores: eu-west=0.501, eu-north=0.499; next tick reverse. hedged fallback fires then rebalances.
sam: smells like a control-theory thermostat: coarse probe sampling + light smoothing -> limit cycle.
maya: options: (A) tighter probe granularity (more cross-region pings), (B) increase EWMA half-life, (C) per-route hysteresis.
katie: (A) increases cross-region probe cost. (B) delays real failover. (C) touches policy DSL surface. tradeoffs.
jordan: prefer runtime-only mitigation first. can we make probe rate adaptive to signal volatility?
sam: idea: compute short-window variance over probe scores; if var > threshold, increase probe rate for that region for T seconds. reduces average probe cost.
maya: implement adapter-level only so no DSL changes. enterprise tenants can still request pinning though.
katie: propose a small optional policy annotation for customers: "region_stability_hint": "pin|prefer|auto" (default auto). keeps DSL change minimal.
jordan: good compromise: runtime adaptive probes + optional hint for enterprise.
alex: caution: hedged fallbacks write telemetry and could amplify variance -> feedback loop. we should filter hedged-origin telemetry from variance calc.
sam: agreed. add a probe_origin label; if origin=="hedge" then exclude from variance window. also add a stabilized_count to avoid flip-flopping on short bursts.
maya: ops/observability asks: add metrics probe_rate{region,tenant}, probe_variance{region}, skipped_hedge_samples. will help validate.
probe-bot: suggestion queued: variance-driven probe throttle heuristic. sim job recommended before rollout.
infra-bot: deploying probe-adapter v2 to canary (deploy=deploy-2026-03-adapt-probe). health checks in progress.
katie: rollout plan: 1) feature-flag runtime adapter behind ff. 2) staging + sim harness 12-24h. 3) canary 1% traffic with SRE watch. 4) opt-in DSL hint in next minor.
jordan: enforce bounds: min_probe_interval = 5s, max_probe_interval = 60s. EWMA half-life floor = 5s to avoid instant reaction. add tests to enforce.
sam: also add a cooldown after region flapping detected so we don't hammer probes during recovery window. cooldown = 30s after huge variance drop.
maya: test matrix: low/high variance, %hedged traffic [0,5,20], enterprise pinned routes, short/long EWMA. spawn synthetic flapping regions.
alex: action items: @maya build prototype adaptive probe adapter + sim tests, @sam add hedged-filter + metrics, @katie draft DSL hint and docs, @jordan add hard bounds + canary playbook. i'll own feature flag and rollout.
katie: tagging @platform-owners @sre @security for visibility.
probe-bot: scheduled sim job: sim-adaptive-probe-flap-2026-03 (ETA ~2.8h).
infra-bot: canary started: logs: "probe-adapter v2 started; feature_flag=adaptive_probe; min_interval=5s"
alex: cool. we'll monitor the first 30m for oscillation drop. thanks all.
maya: +1 :thumbsup:
jordan: +1
